title: minOf over a Pack
prompt: Implement `minOf(first, rest...)` — at least one argument, returns the smallest. Uses pack expansion (a fold with std::min works), and must also handle the single-argument call.

tests.name: multi-argument minimum
tests.hint: Assign as you fold: T m = first; ((m = std::min(m, rest)), ...); return m; — a bare (std::min(first, rest), ...) fold DISCARDS every comparison.

tests.name: single argument
tests.hint: With an empty rest pack, the result is just `first` — the fold over zero elements must not run.
